title: ZoraVibes
tagline: Web3 Music Copyright Royalty distribution in Marketplace with zora protocol
description:
There are layers of middleman between artists and fans when it comes to music distribution, copyright, royalty therefore, no transparency is around the origin of artist payouts.
In this service, when creating an album collection, users can define the desired royalties and determine the required limited edition. It is all decentralized and transparently disclosed in the polygon. and all files are uploaded to IPFS and accessible.
how_its_made: Basically, regarding file access, It was easily implemented using nft.storage. AsksV1_1 module of zora protocol v3 is used to ask the marketplace for music, and when a user purchases the album, it is implemented as a fill the ask. In the case of fill the ask, there was an error in the transaction, but it was not solved due to a lack of time. This was included in the video. NFT and All module is already deployed on polygon mumbai testnet.
